truth_boundary: This is a release design contract, not a claim of subjective perfection. It freezes material roles only when automated structural/browser challenges and release-device visual evidence stay clean.

materials.purpose: selected rows, user bubbles and raised controls
focus, active cognition and interaction clarity

adaptive_material_governor.FULL: Default tier may use bounded blur, glow, elevation and signature accents.
adaptive_material_governor.BALANCED: Reduces expensive blur intensity while preserving hierarchy.
adaptive_material_governor.LITE: Removes nonessential blur/shadow/glow decoration while preserving structure and meaning.

anti_cheapness.principle: Hierarchy, typography, spacing, geometry and restraint outrank decorative effects.

freeze_policy.device_followup: Exact Android release-device visual matrix must remain PASS after promotion.
